title: Will Wiggins: CEO of Baldwin Bone & Joint
summary: This week we welcome Will Wiggins, CEO of Baldwin Bone & Joint, about leading a thriving orthopedic practice that balances growth with quality, drives innovation, and delivers patient-centered care with operational excellence.
body_markdown:
In this episode, we speak with Will Wiggins, CEO of Baldwin Bone & Joint, about leading a thriving orthopedic practice focused on patient-centered care and operational excellence. Will shares insights into balancing growth with quality outcomes and how his team continues to innovate to better serve their community.
